text:
elaine: Quick sync — customer 'Lumos' is pressing to move their tenant-pinning and per-tenant routing into MVP. They also want SSO + p99 < 200ms for their critical flows. Two options: stretch timeline vs cut. Thoughts?

devon: If we stretch, ops needs to rebaseline Dedicated capacity. Could slip infra by ~1 week. Is Lumos willing to commit to reserved capacity? @maria any signal?

maria: They signaled yes for reserved capacity if SLA is in the contract. Legal will need time. Also SSO needs SCIM mapping work — estimate ~5 dev days.

sam: 5 dev days + infra 1 week =~2 weeks. Plus e2e & security review ~3 more days. Realistic sash is ~3 weeks.

chen: Cutting tenant-pinning loses potential ARR from Lumos — roughly ~$50k ARR year one. Are we ok with that risk?

maria: Could do progressive delivery: feature-flagged tenant-pinning for Lumos only. But routing + SSO still need infra/security. Likely a small perf hit unless we rework KV partitioning.

devon: Feature-flag pilot still needs routing layer and KV isolation. Ops estimate: 4d to add tenant routing to gateway + test harness.

elaine: Concrete proposal: Option A (Stretch by ~3w): deliver tenant-pinning + SSO + perf. Option B (Cut to v1): ship core MVP without tenant-pinning. Option C (Flagged pilot): soft-launch for Lumos with limited routing and SSO stub; full infra later. Pick one.

sam: :thinking_face: I prefer Option C if Lumos accepts pilot caveats. Minimizes public risk. Need clear acceptance criteria.

sam: ```Acceptance criteria for Lumos pilot:
- SAML SSO login success rate >= 99% for pilot org
- Tenant routing isolates KV cache namespaces for pilot traffic
- End-to-end p99 for critical flow <= 250ms during pilot (soft limit)
- Legal signs temporary pilot MOU
```

maria: I'll confirm Lumos ok with a pilot MOU. @ops-bot can you schedule infra slot for pilot in the next sprint?

ops-bot: Scheduled: infra slot allocated sprint-23, 4d work, owner devon. Ticket INFRA-4521 created.

devon: :thumbsup: I'll block time. Product needs to freeze API schema for tenant header by EOD.

elaine: API schema freeze by EOD ✅. @chen can you adjust forecast for the potential $50k ARR and mark as contingent?

chen: Done. Marked as contingent revenue and flagged for finance review.

elaine: Summary: we go with Option C (Flagged pilot for Lumos). Stretch = NO for now. Action items: create pilot PRD, draft MOU, infra ticket assigned, API schema freeze. I'll file the PRD and ping PMs. Thanks all.

maria: :party_parrot:
